title: Fri Nov 27, 2026 — early close · weekly expiration

bias.reason: Two-sided into Friday's early close. 7305–09 is still the control line: Monday tagged it (ES high 7313.25 at 7:32 AM PT) and sold off. Tuesday held 7152–7240. Wednesday's 5:30 AM PT data (GDP 4.3% vs 3.5% expected, core PCE 3.3% year-on-year vs 3.2% expected, claims 189k vs 200k, durable goods 0.2% vs 0.7%) flushed ES to 6982.50 at 6:45 AM PT — just above the 6960–66 Monday pivot and a slight undercut of the 6992–93 Sunday overnight low — then ripped to 7211 at 10:50 AM PT, an exact test of the 7211–23 prior highs. As of 11:28 AM PT: ES 7197, SPX 7185, SPY 716.99, QQQ 632.99, NDX 26008.65, VIX 27.97 (Wednesday high 34.95 at 6:45 AM PT). Tuesday closes were SPX 7201.09 (+4.21% vs Friday), SPY 718.78, QQQ 638.10, VIX 26.36. The Monday plan's bull path played out in full and then some: 7025 was reclaimed Sunday, and price ran through 7086, 7120–25 and 7211–23 to tag 7305–09. The bear path to 6897 never triggered; Wednesday's 6982.50 low held the 6960–66 pivot. Friday is a half day (stocks close 10:00 AM PT) and weekly expiration. ES ≈ SPX + 13.5 (Wednesday regular-session median through 11:18 AM PT; the session is still open). The last full options board is Friday's close — not current.

overnight_bias: Thursday is closed. Friday opens after the holiday; size down into a 10:00 AM PT close.

key_levels.note: ES 7305–09 resistance — the control line. Monday's regular-session high was 7313.25 at 7:32 AM PT; it was tagged and sold. No lasting bullish structure until it is accepted.
ES 7240–45 resistance — Tuesday's regular-session high (7240.75 at 7:00 AM PT). A reclaim is the first step toward a 7305–09 retest.
ES 7211–23 resistance — the prior highs and Wednesday's 10:50 AM PT high of 7211, an exact test. First place to sell a bounce; acceptance opens 7240–45.
ES 7120–25 — held as support Monday (low 7167) and Tuesday (low 7152), lost in Wednesday's data flush, reclaimed at 9:17 AM PT.
ES 7086 — mid-range, lost and reclaimed Wednesday morning.
ES 7025–29 — Sunday's reclaim started the bounce; lost and recovered in Wednesday's flush. SPY 700 is about ES 7017 at today's 13.5 basis.
ES 6982–93 support — Wednesday's 5:30 AM PT data low (6982.50 at 6:45 AM PT) and the 6992–93 Sunday overnight low that failed and recovered. The line for Friday.
ES 6960–66 support — Monday's pivot. Not tagged this week; Wednesday's low held 16–28 points above it.
ES 6897–98 support — Friday 11/20's low (12:56 PM PT). Not revisited this week. A loss of 6982 and 6960–66 opens it.

path.bull: Hold 6982–93 and reclaim 7211–23 → 7240–45, then a 7305–09 retest of the control line. Deep midweek dip already recovered once; bounces can still be fast.
path.bear: Fail 6982–93 → 6960–66 (Monday's unused pivot). Lose that → 6897–98 (Friday 11/20's low), then 6841–51.
